title: Deferred: durable MCP-linked workflow handoff sequencing
objective: Replace agent-authored handoff counters with durable ticket-linked workflow events that sequence atomically and bind source identity, timestamps, and evidence references.

acceptance_criteria.text: Workflow event records are durably linked to the relevant ticket and generated from recorded execution/state, not treated as authoritative because an agent narrated them.
Sequence allocation is atomic and monotonic within a documented scope, including concurrent writers and retries; gaps/corrections are explicit and history is append-only.
Each event records actual source identity, timestamp, event type, and stable evidence references; schema and migration are reviewed before implementation.

needed: Design and test atomic sequence allocation under concurrent writers, retries and process interruption.
Verify event-to-ticket linkage, source identity, timestamp and evidence reference integrity; confirm append-only correction behavior.
